models.name: qwen3:8b
models.note: Desk default. The 8B tag is 5.2 GB. An 8 GB Mac cannot run an 8B model well, so 16 GB is the minimum.

models.name: qwen3:4b
models.note: Smaller fallback. The 4B tag is 2.5 GB with a 256K context. 12 GB is the smallest Mac this guide will call enough.

models.name: qwen3:1.7b
models.note: Smallest fallback. The 1.7B tag is 1.4 GB. 8 GB leaves a thin margin after macOS; 4 GB does not.
